targets.queryText: SELECT SUM(total) AS inspected FROM hourly_stats WHERE hour >= strftime('%Y-%m-%d', 'now')
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT SUM(total) AS inspected FROM hourly_stats WHERE hour >= strftime('%Y-%m-%d', 'now')

targets.queryText: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(fail_count) / MAX(SUM(total), 1), 2) AS ng_pct FROM hourly_stats WHERE CAST(strftime('%s', hour || ':00:00') AS INTEGER) BETWEEN $__from / 1000 AND $__to / 1000
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(fail_count) / MAX(SUM(total), 1), 2) AS ng_pct FROM hourly_stats WHERE CAST(strftime('%s', hour || ':00:00') AS INTEGER) BETWEEN $__from / 1000 AND $__to / 1000

targets.queryText: SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', hour || ':00:00') AS INTEGER) AS time, SUM(total) AS total, SUM(fail_count) AS NG FROM hourly_stats WHERE CAST(strftime('%s', hour || ':00:00') AS INTEGER) BETWEEN $__from / 1000 AND $__to / 1000 GROUP BY hour ORDER BY hour

targets.queryText: SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', hour || ':00:00') AS INTEGER) AS time, tool_no || ' ' || COALESCE(tool_name, '') AS tool, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(ng_count) / SUM(count), 2) AS ng_pct FROM hourly_tool_stats WHERE CAST(strftime('%s', hour || ':00:00') AS INTEGER) BETWEEN $__from / 1000 AND $__to / 1000 GROUP BY hour, tool_no ORDER BY hour

targets.queryText: SELECT hour, sensor_id, total, trigger_max - trigger_min + 1 - total AS missing FROM hourly_stats WHERE trigger_resets = 0 AND trigger_max IS NOT NULL AND CAST(strftime('%s', hour || ':00:00') AS INTEGER) BETWEEN $__from / 1000 AND $__to / 1000 AND trigger_max - trigger_min + 1 - total > 0 ORDER BY hour DESC LIMIT 200
